name: California Senate Bill 1119 — Adam's Law (Companion Chatbots: Child Safety and Risk Assessments)
description: California follow-on companion chatbot child-safety legislation expanding SB 243 with mandatory pre-deployment child-safety risk assessments, age assurance, default minor-protection settings, mandatory 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline integration, and biennial independent third-party safety audits.
